rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something that makes someone feel embarrassed or awkward.

example.english: Getting someone's name wrong in the department meeting was really humiliating.
example.traditional: 喺部門開會嗰陣講錯人名，真係好尷尬。
example.jyutping: hai2 bou6 mun4 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 gong2 co3 jan4 meng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaam3 gaai3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on losing face or dignity, especially in front of other people.

example.english: Being told off by the teacher in front of the whole class was really humiliating.
example.traditional: 喺全班同學面前畀老師鬧，真係好丟架。
example.jyutping: hai2 cyun4 baan1 tung4 hok6 min6 cin4 bei2 lou5 si1 naau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

rows.note: Use this in casual speech for a particularly embarrassing or cringe-inducing incident.

example.english: Falling over in the restaurant and getting filmed was so humiliating.
example.traditional: 我喺餐廳跌低仲要畀人影低，真係瘀到爆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 caan1 teng1 dit3 dai1 zung6 jiu1 bei2 jan4 jing2 dai1 zan1 hai6 jyu2 dou3 baau3
